We've been traveling for over 36 hours. The flight to Frankfurt was fast since we passed out the majority of the trip w a little help from our pills. I should have drugged the old ladies behind me who wouldn't shut up.

Layover then off to Delhi. While we still slept on this 7 hr flight, I was crammed in the middle with an old lady who didn't care for personal space (welcome to India) and Andy who's knees barely fit. We landed at 1:30am and passed through customs w/ no issues. As soon as we came down the stairs for customs I could see the air. Maybe the smog leaks in the building. Plus it's hot. People have winter clothes on and I'm sweating in a Tshirt. I hope my body is prepping for the cold we are about to encounter. Another layover and off to Kathmandu. I'm amazing that my body is allowing me to do nothing but sit and sleep and eat w/o freaking out. Good thing I quit exerting before we left.
